command_basis: Driver launches the inner command through evallab docker-lock run har-357-<task_id>-attempt<N>, one launch at a time, with a fresh successful Docker readiness gate before every launch. tasks[].command preserves each exact outer invocation.
verdict_vocabulary: clean = every full-ladder trial rewarded 0 with all 14 attacks executed or legitimately skipped; cracked = some trial rewarded >0; unscored = no reward (failure reason recorded)

totals.prior_attempt_count_basis: All launches are recorded before execution in driver/launches.jsonl and after exit in driver/runs.jsonl. Earlier attempts remain under each task prior_attempts and durable attempts/.
totals.wall_basis: Sum of seven final outer CLI intervals. Including-prior-attempts adds retained earlier outer intervals; readiness and publication remain separate.

limits: These are deterministic local benchmark controls, not model performance. No model calls or cloud compute run. The native agent metadata records model_free=true, zero token usage and cost_usd=0.
A tamper signature refusal rejects the attacked tree before task behaviour is graded. A clean ladder verdict does not itself prove task solvability or verifier validity.
All seven clean verdicts are tamper refusals on the package __init__.py _pytest signature, not graded attacked-tree runs. All seven cells execute all 14 attacks.

The 9 launches of the 10-launch cap run in two driver sessions at commit 8b9e6844b with a clean tree. Session 1 makes 8 launches with at most 2 attempts per task; session 2 raises the per-task limit to 3 and makes the 002736 attempt-3 launch. tasks[].command and jobs_dir keep each launch path.

002736 attempt 1 creates no trial: Harbor exits 1 and the executor log reads "Docker daemon is not running. Please start Docker and try again." The docker info readiness gate returned 0 before that launch. No attack runs.

002736 attempt 2 creates a native trial without a reward. The host-isolation docker info probe times out during environment start; environment setup lasts 47 s and the trial 52 s, yet Harbor reports EnvironmentStartTimeoutError with its configured 1800 s message. No agent/cheat/attempts.json exists, so no attack runs. Attempt 3 at the same digest supplies the clean cell.

Every attempt uses a unique runs/HAR-357 root. All 8 native-trial jobs receive explicit process-job publication with HAR-357 attribution; the no-trial attempt has no job to publish. Raw attempts, logs and publication receipts survive outside the worktree.

Publishing 002736 attempt 3 reused the attempt-2 directory: results_home._origin_key returns source.parent.name, the same format-code-task-002736 for both attempt roots. driver/repub.py republishes the unchanged attempt-2 source (last publish.jsonl row), so attempt 2 is HAR-357-mimo-census-v1-docker-002736-cheat and attempt 3 is HAR-357-mimo-census-v1-docker-002736-cheat~format-code-task-002736. Both match their raw attempt bytes except the regenerated processed/job.json.

Outer wall seconds use a monotonic clock and include the docker-lock queue. Lock queue duration and census-only wall duration are not separately measured. Docker readiness is measured separately before every launch.
Image ID, size and prior cache state are not measured. The driver does not prune Docker, remove images or restart the shared daemon.

All seven native repository-provenance captures record dirty=false, commit 8b9e6844b and the empty-diff SHA. The 002742 tamper log also contains a container distutils-precedence.pth import error; the recorded hit keeps the signature line.
Manifest verify remains unverified. This slice runs no oracle, nop, fix-content probe, model evaluation or repository test suite.
